structured.condensed:
Vuetify component style overrides configuration defining the visual appearance of buttons, text inputs, dialogs, expansion panels, navigation, tooltips and error states in the application.

Buttons: `.v-btn` strips minimum width, text transformation, normalizes letter spacing and adds 0.25rem margin between icons and text. `.button-blue` creates a blue outlined button with $app-blue color on transparent background. Text field labels transform up 8px and scale to 0.75 when active. Dialogs apply 2rem margin, card titles use 1.5em font in $BCgovBlue5 background with $BCgovFontColorInverted color, card text uses 300 font weight in $gray7. Expansion panels remove default box-shadow; `.align-items-top` aligns expand icon to flex-start; `.no-dropdown-icon` hides the icon via `display: none`. Navigation icons add 1rem right margin. Error states override Vuetify defaults: `.error` and related classes apply $app-red to background, border, text and caret; specificity enforced via `.v-application.app-container` selector. Tooltips set 270px width, RGB(73,80,87) background with white text, 4px border-radius, $px-12 font size; pseudo-element `:after` draws right-side arrow; `.top-tooltip:after` draws top-pointing arrow. Disabled text buttons set 0.4 opacity and $app-blue color on icon and text.

GOTCHA: Error colour overrides use high specificity selectors (`.v-application.app-container .error`) to force override of Vuetify defaults; this approach is fragile to DOM structure changes. Tooltip arrow positioning uses absolute positioning with hard-coded pixel values (10px, 8px margins) which may break if content padding changes.

structured.condensed:
Displays the header of a business entity or filing application in the BCRS system, showing the entity name, description, and status badges.

Entry point: EntityHeader component receives businessId and tempRegNumber as props. No permission checks shown.

Flow: If businessId exists, displays entity name from getEntityName (or "Unknown Name"), business description derived from legal type via GetCorpFullDescription. If isHistorical is true, shows "HISTORICAL" chip and reason text (getReasonText or "Unknown Reason"). Otherwise shows conditional badges: "LIMITED RESTORATION" if isInLimitedRestoration with active-until date (getLimitedRestorationActiveUntil or "Unknown"), and "AUTHORIZED TO CONTINUE OUT" if isAuthorizedToContinueOut. If tempRegNumber exists instead, displays entity name and bootstrapFilingDescription.

bootstrapFilingDescription decision tree: Returns display name from first task if isAmalgamationTodo; first filing if isAmalgamationFiling; first task if isContinuationInTodo; first pending if isContinuationInPending; first filing if isContinuationInFiling; otherwise constructs description using businessDescription + either REGISTRATION (for SOLE_PROP or PARTNERSHIP) or INCORPORATION_APPLICATION.

businessDescription decision: If sole proprietor with tempRegNumber, returns corpFullDescription + " / Doing Business As (DBA)"; otherwise just corpFullDescription.

Reads from stores: getEntityName, getLegalType, isEntitySoleProp, isHistorical, getFilings, isAuthorizedToContinueOut, getLimitedRestorationActiveUntil, getReasonText, getPendingsList, getTasks, isAmalgamationFiling, isAmalgamationTodo, isContinuationInFiling, isContinuationInPending, isContinuationInTodo, isInLimitedRestoration.

uses.what: Called with getLegalType to retrieve corporation type description

uses.what: Reads getEntityName, getLegalType, isEntitySoleProp, isHistorical from business store

uses.what: Reads getFilings and isAuthorizedToContinueOut from filing history store

structured.condensed: A menu component that displays business actions available to a user based on entity type and permissions. It determines which actions to show—AGM extension, AGM location change, amalgamation, consent filings, business information edits, and dissolution—by checking the entity's legal type against feature flags and calling isAllowed() with specific AllowableActions. When a user clicks "Change Business Information" or "Dissolve this Business", the component either navigates to the Edit UI with a specific filing type (special-resolution, change, or alteration) or emits a notInGoodStanding event if the business is not in good standing and the user is not staff. Navigation and dissolution confirmation are delegated to router.push() or events. Entry point: component receives businessId and computes visibility via getters reading business store state and configuration feature flags. GOTCHA: two commented-out getters (isEntityCoop, isEntityFirm) are referenced in methods but undefined, causing runtime errors.

structured.condensed:
A Vue mixin that determines which filing and administrative actions are allowed for a business entity based on its legal type, standing, user role, and feature flags.

The mixin reads business state—legal type (COOP, firm, sole proprietorship), standing, staff role—and feature flags from LaunchDarkly via `GetFeatureFlag`. The public method `isAllowed` takes an `AllowableActions` enum value and returns true or false. It routes each action through a switch statement: most actions call the private helper `isAllowedFiling`, which checks whether a filing type (and optional subtype) exists in the `getAllowedActions.filing.filingTypes` array from store state; some actions like `BUSINESS_SUMMARY` and `DETAIL_COMMENT` add additional conditions (entity type, feature flag, staff role, or the presence of a session `BUSINESS_ID`). `DIGITAL_CREDENTIALS` additionally checks `getAllowedActions.digitalBusinessCard`. No entry point shows a permission check; this mixin is called from UI to determine what to display.

GOTCHA: The default case returns `false` silently, masking unknown action values.

uses.name: useBusinessStore
uses.what: Business store providing getAllowedActions (filing types and subtypes array), getLegalType (CorpTypeCd), isEntityCoop, isEntityFirm, isEntitySoleProp, isGoodStanding getters.

uses.what: Root store providing isRoleStaff getter.

uses.name: GetFeatureFlag
uses.what: Reads feature flags from LaunchDarkly by key (supported-dissolution-entities, special-resolution-ui-enabled, supported-business-summary-entities, supported-correction-entities, enable-digital-credentials, supported-restoration-entities, supported-put-back-on-entities).

structured.condensed:
A Vue mixin that builds filing objects and manages filing codes for business entity corrections, dissolutions, and restorations.

Inbound: via five public methods that accept filing codes, correction types, or restoration types. No checks shown. Outbound: constructs `CorrectionFilingIF`, `DissolutionFilingIF`, or `RestorationFilingIF` objects with header (current date, filing type name), business (identifier, legal name, legal type, and dates/founding dates per filing type), and filing-type-specific data (correction comment and corrected filing details; dissolution type and custodial office; restoration type).

`updateFilingData` adds or removes filing codes and flags: accepts `action` ('add'|'remove'), `filingCode` (optional), `priority` (boolean|undefined), `waiveFees` (boolean|undefined). Always removes the code if present; if `action==='add'` and filingCode exists, re-adds it with the flags set. If no filingCode, applies the flags to all existing codes. Calls `setFilingData` (pinia action) with the mutated array.

`hasFilingCode` searches filingData for a code and returns a boolean; no condition.

`buildCorrectionFiling` formats a correction from `correctedFiling.submittedDate` (converted to YYYY-MM-DD), `correctedFiling.filingId`, and `correctedFiling.name`; takes `correctionType` enum; leaves `comment` empty string.

`buildDissolutionFiling` and `buildRestorationFiling` populate their structures from getters; dissolution switches on `getLegalType` to set custodialOffice for sole proprietors and partnerships (to `getBusinessAddress`) or registered office address otherwise. Restoration type passed as parameter.

GOTCHA: no permission or duplicate guard shown; `legalName` is noted as "may be undefined".

structured.condensed:
Utility methods for timezone-aware date conversions between UTC, Pacific time, and API format. Converts between ISO date strings (YYYY-MM-DD in Pacific), JavaScript Date objects, human-readable formats (Month Day, Year at HH:MM am/pm Pacific time), and API datetime strings (UTC with +00:00 offset).

Entry points: `getServerDate()` fetches server time via HEAD request to bypass browser's local clock; `yyyyMmDdToDate()`, `createUtcDate()`, `dateToYyyyMmDd()`, `formatYyyyMmDd()`, `dateToPacificDate()`, `dateToPacificTime()`, `dateToPacificDateTime()`, `dateToApi()`, `apiToDate()`, `apiToPacificDate()`, `apiToPacificDateTime()`, `apiToUtcString()`, `apiToYyyyMmDd()`, and `yyyyMmDdToApi()` convert dates between formats. Each static method validates input (null, length 10 for strings, valid Date).

`getServerDate()` receives HTTP response headers via fetch to `window.location.origin + VUE_APP_PATH` with cache: 'no-store' and HEAD method; on error, falls back to local `new Date()`. Converts Date strings from GMT header. This chunk shows no permission check.

Core flow: Pacific timezone conversions use `toLocaleString()` with timeZone: 'America/Vancouver' to compute UTC offset, then adjust date by offset. API formats use ISO string with +00:00 instead of Z.

GOTCHA: `getServerDate()` silently falls back to browser date on any network error, which may contain invalid date/time per comments. GOTCHA: `apiToDate()` truncates precision by slicing input to 19 characters, losing milliseconds.

structured.condensed:
Utility functions for date comparison and arithmetic in YYYY-MM-DD format.

Receives two date strings (ApiDateTimeUtc) and an operator; `compareYyyyMmDd` strips hyphens, converts to numeric form, and returns the result of eval'd comparison—no input validation guards against malformed dates. `earliestYyyyMmDd` and `latestYyyyMmDd` each return the earlier or later date, handling nulls by returning the non-null date or null if both absent. `daysBetweenTwoDates` takes two Date objects, zeros their times, and returns the rounded day difference. `isDatePast` and `isDateFuture` compare a FormattedDateTimeGmt string against the current time. `addMonthsToDate` accepts a month count and YYYY-MM-DD string (length checked to 10 chars), converts to Date, adds months, and returns YYYY-MM-DD; returns null on missing input or wrong length. `subtractDates` takes two YYYY-MM-DD strings (length checked to 10), calculates month and year differences, and adjusts down by one if the day-of-month comparison suggests a month hasn't completed.

GOTCHA: `compareYyyyMmDd` uses eval() for string comparison operators, accepting any operator passed in without validation. GOTCHA: `compareYyyyMmDd` returns true on missing inputs rather than raising an error. GOTCHA: `daysBetweenTwoDates` mutates the input Date objects by calling setHours().

structured.condensed:
Helper functions for business filing status and type classification in a filing system.

Takes an item object and returns boolean for one specific status or filing type. Status checks: item.status compared against FilingStatus.APPROVED, AWAITING_REVIEW, CANCELLED, CHANGE_REQUESTED, COMPLETED, CORRECTED, DELETED, DRAFT, ERROR, NEW, PAID, PENDING, PENDING_CORRECTION, REJECTED, or WITHDRAWN. Type checks: item.name compared against FilingTypes constants (AGM_EXTENSION, AGM_LOCATION_CHANGE, AMALGAMATION_APPLICATION, ALTERATION, ANNUAL_REPORT, CHANGE_OF_ADDRESS, CHANGE_OF_COMPANY_INFO, CHANGE_OF_DIRECTORS, CHANGE_OF_NAME, CHANGE_OF_REGISTRATION, CONSENT_AMALGAMATION_OUT, CONSENT_CONTINUATION_OUT, CONTINUATION_IN, CONTINUATION_OUT, CONVERSION, CORRECTION, DISSOLUTION, DISSOLVED, INCORPORATION_APPLICATION, REGISTRATION, RESTORATION, TRANSITION, REGISTRARS_NOTATION, REGISTRARS_ORDER, PUT_BACK_ON, ADMIN_FREEZE, COURT_ORDER, SPECIAL_RESOLUTION); or item.filingSubType/item.name checked for amalgamation subtypes (AMALGAMATION_REGULAR, AMALGAMATION_HORIZONTAL, AMALGAMATION_VERTICAL via either filingSubType or amalgamationApplication.type); or item.filingSubType/item.dissolution checked for dissolution subtypes (DISSOLUTION_ADMINISTRATIVE, DISSOLUTION_INVOLUNTARY, DISSOLUTION_VOLUNTARY); or item.filingSubType/item.restoration checked for restoration subtypes (FULL_RESTORATION via either filingSubType or restoration.type). No entry point enforcement shown. No output side effects.

structured.condensed: Type and payment method classifier utility for business filings. Three static methods test filing type against the restoration subtype property on todo/filing items or state filings: isTypeRestorationLimited, isTypeRestorationLimitedExtension, isTypeRestorationLimitedToFull check filingSubType or restoration.type against LIMITED_RESTORATION, LIMITED_RESTORATION_EXTENSION, LIMITED_RESTORATION_TO_FULL respectively. isTypeStaff returns true if the item is any of six staff-initiated filing types via calls to isTypeAdminFreeze, isTypeCourtOrder, isTypeDissolutionAdministrative, isTypePutBackOn, isTypeRegistrarsNotation, isTypeRegistrarsOrder. Four payment method classifiers test paymentMethod: isPayMethodCreditCard, isPayMethodDirectPay, isPayMethodDrawdown, isPayMethodOnlineBanking. isEffectOfOrderPlanOfArrangement tests effectOfOrder against PLAN_OF_ARRANGEMENT. filingTypeToName converts FilingTypes enum to human-readable name, appending agmYear to annual reports and selecting restoration subtype name (CONVERSION, EXTENSION, FULL, LIMITED, or APPLICATION) based on subType parameter; falls back to camelCaseToWords if type unknown. camelCaseToWords splits camelCase/PascalCase on uppercase boundaries and title-cases, hardcoding 'Agm' to 'AGM'. dissolutionTypeToName converts dissolution subtype to name, branching on isEntityFirm for voluntary dissolution (FIRM or VOLUNTARY).

structured.condensed:
Fetches and writes business, filing, and party data via REST endpoints, creating drafts and filing documents.

What comes in: business ID (entity inc no), filing ID, temp registration number, name request number with phone/email, document info, role filter, and filing objects. What goes out: business object, filing list, filing object, tasks/addresses/parties/comments/documents as API responses, PDF blob for download, or null if name request not found.

Main flow: GET requests to `businesses/{businessId}` and child resources; POST to `businesses?draft=true` or `businesses/{businessId}/filings` with filing object; PUT to `businesses/{businessId}/filings/{filingId}` with filing object. For `fetchNameRequest`: GET `nameRequests/{nrNumber}/validate?phone={phone}&email={email}` returns data or null (404), throws on 400 or 403 with specific messages. For `fetchDocument`: validates link and filename present, GETs PDF with Accept header, handles blob creation and browser download via link click (IE fallback with msSaveOrOpenBlob).

Decisions: `fetchBusiness`, `fetchFilings`, `createFiling`, `updateFiling`, `fetchComments`, `fetchDocuments`, `fetchFiling` throw "Invalid" error if response lacks expected data field. `fetchNameRequest` returns null on 404 (not error), throws on 400 (invalid email/phone) or 403 (missing email/phone), re-raises others. `createFiling` and `updateFiling` append `?draft=true` if isDraft true. `fetchParties` appends `?role={role}` if role provided. `fetchDocument` throws if document.link or document.filename missing, uses Navigator.msSaveOrOpenBlob if available else creates ObjectURL with link click.

This chunk shows no entry-point checks; callers enforce permissions elsewhere. Errors logged to console (eslint-disable-next-line no-console) before throwing; no retry logic, no transactional guards.

GOTCHA: `fetchDocument` creates temporary DOM element and invokes click; side effects not easily testable.

structured.condensed:
This is a Vue component template and script for an AGM Extension filing UI: it collects business details, extension request parameters, and certifier information, evaluates eligibility, displays fees, and submits the filing with optional payment.

Incoming: filingId route query parameter (must be 0 for new filing, else redirects to dashboard); user info from store (firstname, lastname for pre-population if not staff). Outgoing: filing saved via LegalServices with filing data including FilingCodes.AGM_EXTENSION; payment redirect to PayApiUrl if fee required; user returns to dashboard via goToDashboard().

Main flow: (1) Page validates filingId is 0 on creation, else exits. (2) On mount, populates currentDate, isGoodStanding, incorporationDate into data object; pre-fills certifiedBy with logged-in user name unless staff role. (3) User enters extension details in AboutTheBusiness, ExtensionRequest, and AgmExtensionEvaluation sub-components; each updates data.sync; ExtensionRequest emits extensionRequestValid flag. (4) Certify component collects certifiedBy and isCertified, emits certifyFormValid. (5) On "File and Pay" click, checks isPageValid (both extensionRequestValid and certifyFormValid); if invalid, sets showErrors=true to trigger child validation displays and scrolls to first error.

Decisions: isPageValid requires extensionRequestValid && certifyFormValid; busySaving blocks buttons while filingPaying=true; isPayRequired (totalFee > 0) determines button text "File and Pay" vs "File Now (no fee)"; isRoleStaff=true disables Certify edit and skips pre-population.

Incoming: filingId route query parameter (must be 0 for new filing, else redirects to dashboard); user info from store (firstname, lastname for pre-population if not staff). Outgoing: filing saved via LegalServices with filing data including FilingCodes.AGM_EXTENSION; payment redirect to PayApiUrl if fee required; user returns to dashboard via goToDashboard().

(4) Certify component collects certifiedBy and isCertified, emits certifyFormValid. (5) On "File and Pay" click, checks isPageValid (both extensionRequestValid and certifyFormValid); if invalid, sets showErrors=true to trigger child validation displays and scrolls to first error.

Decisions: isPageValid requires extensionRequestValid && certifyFormValid; busySaving blocks buttons while filingPaying=true; isPayRequired (totalFee > 0) determines button text "File and Pay" vs "File Now (no fee)"; isRoleStaff=true disables Certify edit and skips pre-population.

structured.condensed: AGM Extension filing component for a business application, part of a web UI. Saves a final (non-draft) filing, handles payment or save errors, then navigates to payment or dashboard. Entry point `onClickFilePay` checks `this.data.isEligible` and `this.busySaving`; this chunk shows both checks. Calls `saveFiling(false)` which builds a filing object (header with name, certifiedBy, date; business with foundingDate, identifier, legalName, legalType; data with agmYear, isFirstAgm, extReqForAgmYear, totalApprovedExt, expireDateApprovedExt, and conditional prevAgmRefDate and expireDateCurrExt). If save returns status 402, sets `haveChanges = false`, shows `paymentErrorDialog`, and returns filed data; other errors set `saveErrorReason = SaveErrorReasons.FILE_PAY` and return filed data. On success, `onClickFilePayFinish` checks `filingId > 0`, reads `savedFiling.header.isPaymentActionRequired`, and if true navigates to a payment URL built from `paymentToken` and return URL; else routes to dashboard. `goToDashboard(force)` checks `haveChanges` and prompts via `confirm` dialog if unsaved changes exist. `onPaymentErrorDialogExit` closes payment dialog and routes to dashboard for non-staff, or leaves dialog open for staff. Watchers on data properties set `haveChanges = true`. GOTCHA: Caller catches `saveFiling` exceptions; no retry on error responses.

Presents fields for calendar year of AGM, reason for location change, and AGM location outside BC; validates each field and shows errors. structured.condensed: Vue component for entering and filing an AGM location change filing. Entry point: user clicks File and Pay button. On click, validates all fields (agmLocation, agmYear, certifiedBy, reason); if invalid, displays errors and scrolls to first invalid component. If valid and not already saving, calls saveFiling(false) to build and post the filing to the server. On success with payment required, extracts paymentToken and filingId from response, displays PaymentErrorDialog. On success without payment required, navigates to dashboard with filingId parameter. On error with status 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED, displays PaymentErrorDialog and saves filingId if present. On other save errors, sets saveErrorReason to FILE_PAY and lets error dialog retry. Before save, checks via LegalServices.hasPendingTasks(getIdentifier) whether another draft exists; if so, throws error. saveFiling constructs filing payload with header (name: FilingTypes.AGM_LOCATION_CHANGE, certifiedBy, date: getCurrentDate), business (foundingDate, identifier, legalName, legalType), and data (year: agmYear, reason, agmLocation: agmLocation). Validation rules: agmLocation required and ≤400 chars; agmYear required and between minAgmYear (today − 2) and maxAgmYear (today + 1). Page valid when agmLocationValid AND agmYearValid AND certifyFormValid AND reasonValid. haveChanges flag set to false only after successful save or successful file-pay. No explicit retry logic shown for failed saveFiling; caller handles. GOTCHA: onClickFilePayFinish() checks filingId > 0 but logs null instead of savedFiling on ID failure.

Vue component for AGM Location Change business filing. Saves or updates a filing by merging header, business, and data fields, then calls LegalServices to create (filingId = 0) or update (filingId > 0) the filing; stores response errors and warnings in saveErrors and saveWarnings; throws the error. Navigates to dashboard via goToDashboard, which checks haveChanges: if false or force=true, routes immediately; else opens a confirmation dialog prompting user—Yes stays in filing, Cancel clears haveChanges and routes to dashboard. onPaymentErrorDialogExit closes the payment error dialog and routes staff to dashboard or non-staff to dashboard. Component tracks changes across agmYear, agmLocation, certifiedBy, isCertified, and reason properties. validComponents array and validFlags object (agmYear, reason, location, certifyForm) validate form sections; a commented-out mainSection flag suggests incomplete validation. Styles number h2 headers and format validation error states in red.

GOTCHA: Error extraction from response only—no guarantee the response object exists or has the expected shape. GOTCHA: haveChanges flag set to false only when user cancels exit, not when filing is saved. GOTCHA: mainSection validation is commented out, leaving the form potentially incomplete.

structured.condensed:
Renders a form for filing an Amalgamation Out business transaction, collecting ledger detail, effective date, foreign jurisdiction details, business name, document delivery emails, certifier name, and court order information before saving.

Displays a loading container with indeterminate progress circle and message while data loads. Once dataLoaded is true, renders main form with six sections: (1) Ledger Detail—text input accepting up to maxDetailCommentLength chars, displays defaultComment, validity emitted from DetailComment component; (2) Effective Date of Amalgamation—EffectiveDate component with initialEffectiveDate and showErrors validation trigger; (3) Jurisdiction Information—ForeignJurisdiction component initialized with initialCountry and initialRegion; (4) Business Information—BusinessNameForeign component initialized with initialBusinessName; (5) Documents Delivery—DocumentDelivery component showing getBusinessEmail as Business Office contact, editable by isRoleStaff, optional email toggled; (6) Certify—Certify component requiring legal name of authorized person, message from certifyText(FilingCodes.AMALGAMATION_OUT), isCertified toggled via checkbox; (7) Court Order and Plan of Arrangement—CourtOrderPoa component with courtOrderNumberRequired false, fileNumber optional, hasPlanOfArrangement flag. All sections highlight red borders when showErrors is true and their validity flag is false. Right sidebar shows SbcFeeSummary with filingData and payURL, emitting totalFee. Bottom has Save button (disabled/loading while busySaving), Save and Resume Later button. Each form section emits validity state; component maintains detailCommentValid, effectiveDateValid, foreignJurisdictionValid, businessNameValid, documentDeliveryValid, certifyFormValid, courtOrderValid. Buttons trigger onClickSave() and onClickSaveResume() handlers. ResumeErrorDialog and SaveErrorDialog show with resumeErrorDialog and saveErrorReason state; SaveErrorDialog has saveErrors, saveWarnings arrays and disableRetry while busySaving, calls onSaveErrorDialogRetry() and onSaveErrorDialogOkay(). ConfirmDialog attached to #amalgamation-out.

structured.condensed:
UI component for an Amalgamation Out filing—a staff-only business dissolution form that requires jurisdiction, business name, effective date, detail comment, court order information, and electronic certification before filing with optional payment.

Entry point: created() lifecycle—checks caller is role Staff (throws error if not); mounted() lifecycle loads draft filing by filingId from query param, or prepares new filing using business legal name.

Inputs: filingId (0=new, >0=draft) from route query; fetched filing response includes filing.header.certifiedBy, filing.amalgamationOut.courtOrder (fileNumber, effectOfOrder), amalgamationOutDate, foreignJurisdiction (country, region), legalName.

Main form fields with validation: detailComment (max 2000 minus default "Amalgamation Out" prefix), effectiveDate, foreignJurisdiction (country/region), businessNameForeign, courtOrderPoa (fileNumber, hasPlanOfArrangement via effectOfOrder), certify (isCertified, certifiedBy), documentDelivery (optional email).

Decision on isPageValid: true if all child component refs report valid (detailCommentValid, effectiveDateValid, foreignJurisdictionValid, businessNameValid, documentDeliveryValid, courtOrderValid, certifyFormValid).

Decision on isPayRequired: true if totalFee > 0.

Outputs: onClickFilePay() calls to file and pay (loading state filingPaying); goToDashboard() cancels. Button disabled while busySaving (saving || savingResuming || filingPaying). Unload warning if haveChanges. Safety check: throws "This is a Staff only Filing" if not isRoleStaff.

structured.condensed:
Handles user interactions for saving and filing an Amalgamation Out business filing—Save, Save and Resume Later, or File and Pay—updating a draft or final filing via LegalServices and managing error states.

User clicks Save: prevents double-save via `busySaving`, calls `saveFiling(true)` to save draft, extracts filingId from response, clears `haveChanges` if no error, else shows error dialog. Calls `onClickSaveFinish()` if no error.

User clicks Save and Resume Later: same flow as Save, but calls `onClickSaveResumeFinish()` if no error, which also navigates to dashboard.

User clicks File and Pay: first validates all form fields (`isPageValid`, `detailCommentValid`, `certifyFormValid`); if invalid, scrolls to first error and returns. Prevents double-save via `busySaving`, calls `saveFiling(false)` for final filing. On 402 Payment Required, clears `haveChanges` and returns filing from response. On other error, sets `saveErrorReason = SaveErrorReasons.FILE_PAY`. Extracts filingId. If no error, calls `onClickFilePayFinish()`.

`onClickFilePayFinish()`: if filingId > 0, clears `haveChanges`. If `isPaymentActionRequired`, extracts `paymentToken` and navigates to payment URL via `getAuthWebUrl + 'makepayment/' + paymentToken`, else navigates to business dashboard.

`saveFiling(isDraft)`: for new filing (filingId === 0), calls `LegalServices.hasPendingTasks(getIdentifier)`; if true or error, throws. Builds filing object with header (name: FilingTypes.AMALGAMATION_OUT, certifiedBy, email, date), business (foundingDate, identifier, legalName, legalType), and data (details, amalgamationOutDate, foreignJurisdiction with country/region, legalName). Conditionally includes courtOrder if fileNumber provided. Sets waiveFees: true. Calls `LegalServices.updateFiling()` if filingId > 0, else `LegalServices.createFiling()`, passing isDraft. On error, extracts errors/warnings from response. Caller must catch exceptions.

`goToDashboard(force)`: if no `haveChanges` or force=true, navigates to dashboard, else opens confirmation dialog; cancel clears `haveChanges` and navigates.

`onSaveErrorDialogRetry()`: dispatches retry to `onClickSave()`, `onClickSaveResume()`, or `onClickFilePay()` based on `saveErrorReason`.

Entry points: `onClickSave`, `onClickSaveResume`, `onClickFilePay(staffPayment)`, `onClickFilePayFinish`, `onClickSaveFinish`, `onClickSaveResumeFinish`, `goToDashboard(force)`, `onSaveErrorDialogRetry`. This chunk shows no permission check.

GOTCHA: no duplicate guard between checking `busySaving` and setting `saving`/`savingResuming`; separate flags allow concurrent operations. GOTCHA: filingId validity checked only in finish methods; if saveFiling fails silently and returns no filing, filingId stays 0 but `haveChanges` may be cleared. GOTCHA: `getCurrentDate` is reassigned by API; local value sent is not stored. GOTCHA: Payment URL navigation assumes reachability; no retry or fallback on 4xx/5xx.

uses.name: LegalServices.hasPendingTasks
uses.what: POST/GET to check if pending tasks exist for identifier; throws if fails; no credential or check shown.

uses.name: LegalServices.updateFiling
uses.what: POST to update existing filing by filingId with filing object and isDraft flag; response contains filing with header.filingId, header.isPaymentActionRequired, header.paymentToken; throws on error.

uses.name: LegalServices.createFiling
uses.what: POST to create new filing with filing object and isDraft flag; response contains filing with header.filingId, header.isPaymentActionRequired, header.paymentToken; throws on error.

uses.name: getIdentifier
uses.what: Business identifier used in LegalServices calls and navigation; no check shown.

uses.name: getBusinessEmail
uses.what: Email address included in filing header.

uses.name: getCurrentDate
uses.what: Date included in filing header; API will overwrite.

uses.name: getFoundingDate
uses.what: Business founding date converted to API format via dateToApi().

uses.name: getLegalName
uses.what: Legal name of business entity included in filing.

uses.name: getLegalType
uses.what: Legal type of business included in filing.

uses.name: getAuthWebUrl
uses.what: Base URL for payment endpoint; paymentToken and returnUrl appended to form makepayment URL.

uses.name: navigate
uses.what: External function called with payment URL to navigate browser; assumed reachable.

uses.name: navigateToBusinessDashboard
uses.what: External function to route to dashboard with optional filingId parameter.

uses.name: validateAndScroll
uses.what: Scrolls to first invalid component in validFlags and validComponents.

uses.name: FilingTypes.AMALGAMATION_OUT
uses.what: Constant for filing type name and data key.

uses.name: EffectOfOrderTypes.PLAN_OF_ARRANGEMENT
uses.what: Constant for court order effect type.

uses.name: SaveErrorReasons.SAVE
uses.what: Constant for save error reason.

uses.name: SaveErrorReasons.SAVE_RESUME
uses.what: Constant for save-resume error reason.

uses.name: SaveErrorReasons.FILE_PAY
uses.what: Constant for file-pay error reason.

uses.what: HTTP 402 status code constant checked in onClickFilePay error handling.

structured.condensed: Handles user actions completing a save-error dialog in a business filing form. Entry point `onSaveErrorDialogOkay` receives control when user clicks OK; this chunk shows no permission check. Reads `saveErrorReason` to route to one of three completion handlers: `onClickSaveFinish`, `onClickSaveResumeFinish`, or `onClickFilePayFinish` (or does nothing if reason matches none). Also defines validation state: `validComponents` array names seven form sections, and `validFlags` getter returns an object mapping flag names to their validity booleans (detailComment, effectiveDate, foreignJurisdiction, businessInformation, documentDelivery, certifyForm, courtOrder). Watchers on four flags trigger `onHaveChanges`, which sets `haveChanges` to true. Styles the form with numbered h2 headings via CSS counter, grey text and spacing, and red text for invalid sections.

structured.condensed:
Vue component template and script that presents three amalgamation type options (horizontal short-form, vertical short-form, regular long-form) for business filing; clicking a button creates a draft amalgamation application and redirects to the corresponding form page.

**Incoming:** User navigates to component. On creation, if no business identifier in store, redirects to dashboard (DASHBOARD route or business dashboard URL based on feature flag 'use-business-dashboard'). Reads business type, legal name, email, phone from stores.

**Outgoing:** `startAmalgamation()` calls `createBusinessAA()` with amalgamation type and business data. On success, navigates to Create UI URL ('amalg-short-information' route for short-form or 'amalg-reg-information' for regular long-form, appending businessId query param). On failure, logs error, shows TechnicalErrorDialog, does not retry.

**Flow and decisions:** `getRegularAmalgamationText()` returns result company type string (BC limited company, BC community contribution company, BC unlimited liability company, or Unknown) based on entity type getters. `legalType` getter maps current entity type to CorpTypeCd; throws error if no match. `isShortFormAmalgamation()` called to branch form routing; implementation not shown. For short-form, `createBusinessAA()` sets legal name to current business name and correctNameOption to CORRECT_AML_ADOPT; otherwise both undefined. Email and phone set to business values if short-form and present, else empty string.

**Entry point:** Component created; this chunk shows no check enforcing access control.

**GOTCHA:** `createBusinessAA()` implementation incomplete in chunk; service endpoint, HTTP method, credentials, full payload not shown. Default 'Unknown' and error throw noted as "should never happen" but not verified.

structured.condensed: Builds a draft business filing for an amalgamation application. Creates a filing object with header (name, account ID), business legalType, and amalgamationApplication details (name request, contact point). By amalgamation type—HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, or REGULAR—sets the current business as PRIMARY, HOLDING, or AMALGAMATING role respectively in the amalgamatingBusinesses array. Calls LegalServices.createDraftBusiness with the assembled filing; throws on error (handled by caller) and returns the business identifier from the response, or throws if identifier is missing. Also defines isShortFormAmalgamation helper that returns true for HORIZONTAL or VERTICAL types. No permission checks shown; identifier is extracted via casting without validation of its structure.

structured.condensed: Annual Report filing page for cooperatives and base companies. Entry point for filing flow shows different form layouts by entity type. For cooperatives: collects Annual General Meeting date, office addresses, and directors; for base companies: displays readonly summary of those. All paths converge at certification step. Flow shows four sections (AGM date, addresses, directors, certify for coops; business details, directors, certify for companies), gated by agmDateValid. Components bind data two-way to updatedAddresses, updatedDirectors, newAgmDate, newAgmExtension, newNoAgm, isCertified, certifiedBy. Dialog overlays handle fetch errors, payment errors (with saveErrors, saveWarnings), save errors (disableRetry when busySaving, allows retry/okay/exit), resume errors, staff payment. Loading states: showLoadingContainer with loadingMessage, and isFetching overlay. SbcFeeSummary calculates totalFee from filingData and payURL from getPayApiUrl. Calls allowChange('coa'), allowChange('cod') to gate modifications. On AGM date valid, shows addresses and directors sections. Directors component tracks directorsPaidChange, directorsFreeChange, directorEditInProgress. Addresses/Directors components fetch originalAddresses and originalDirectors on mount. Calls displayName() for entity display in certify. No check shown for who may view or submit this page.

uses.what: Resume errors dialog; exits via goToDashboard(true).

uses.what: Save errors with retry disabled when busySaving; three exit paths: exit clears saveErrorReason, retry calls onSaveErrorDialogRetry(), okay calls onSaveErrorDialogOkay().

uses.what: Handler for director free status change.

uses.what: Boolean to show 'Fetching updated data' overlay during refresh.

uses.name: fetchErrorDialog
uses.what: Boolean visibility for fetch error dialog.

uses.name: paymentErrorDialog

uses.name: resumeErrorDialog
uses.what: Boolean visibility for resume error dialog.

uses.name: updatedAddresses

uses.what: Two-way bound AGM extension flag from AgmDate component.

uses.name: newNoAgm

uses.name: agmDate

uses.what: Boolean validation state from OfficeAddresses component.

uses.name: isCertified

uses.name: certifiedBy

uses.what: Boolean validation state from Certify component.

structured.condensed:
UI template and component for the Annual Report filing form in a business registry system. Renders action buttons and orchestrates the filing workflow with conditional rendering for cooperative versus other business entity types.

Entry point is the AnnualReport component class, invoked when the user navigates with route query parameters `filingId` and `arFilingYear`. No permission check shown; relies on prior authentication.

Two button containers render conditionally: one for cooperatives (`isEntityCoop` true) showing Save, Save and Resume Later, and File and Pay buttons; another for base companies (BEN/BC/CC/ULC/CBEN/C/CCC/CUL) showing only File and Pay. All action buttons disable when `busySaving` (saving, savingResuming, or filingPaying) is true. File and Pay also disables when `isPageValid` is false.

Main flow collects AGM Date (cooperatives only), office addresses, directors, and certification before filing. For cooperatives, `asOfDate` is the AGM date if set, else the last day of the filing year if it is past, else today. For base companies, `asOfDate` is `nextARDate`. Payment is required if `totalFee` is greater than zero.

Decisions: `isEntityCoop` (from store) routes to coop or base company button set. `isPageValid` checks `agmDateValid`, `addressesFormValid`, `directorFormValid`, `certifyFormValid`, and not `directorEditInProgress` for coops; only `certifyFormValid` for others. `showLoadingContainer` displays loader when `dataLoaded` is false and all error dialogs are hidden. `certifyMessage` varies by entity type via `FilingCodes.ANNUAL_REPORT_BC` or `ANNUAL_REPORT_OT`.

Calls: `onClickSave()`, `onClickSaveResume()`, `onClickFilePay()`, `goToDashboard()` trigger on button click. Component emits `fetch-error-event` listener. Component mounts dialogs: ConfirmDialog, FetchErrorDialog, SaveErrorDialog, ResumeErrorDialog, PaymentErrorDialog, StaffPaymentDialog. Child components receive props and emit validity state: AgmDate, ArDate, Directors, OfficeAddresses, Certify, SummaryDirectors, SummaryOfficeAddresses, SbcFeeSummary.

Window `onbeforeunload` checks `haveChanges` and prompts if true.

GOTCHA: `asOfDate` logic for cooperatives uses `getCurrentYear` from root store; if `ARFilingYear` is NaN the comparison fails silently. structured.condensed:
Initializes and manages an Annual Report filing form component in a Vue web application.

Entry point: `mounted()` lifecycle hook, called by Vue when component attaches to DOM; no check shown. Validates required data (getIdentifier, ARFilingYear, filingId; for coops: arMinDate, arMaxDate; for base companies: nextARDate); if missing, logs to console and calls `goToDashboard(true)`, returning early. If filingId > 0, fetches draft filing via `fetchDraftFiling()` and restores original office addresses and directors unless in Vitest. Otherwise prepares new filing by fetching original addresses and directors. Sets `dataLoaded = true`. For base companies, immediately adds ANNUAL_REPORT_BC filing code with existing priority and waive-fees flags; for coops, code added when AGM date becomes valid.

`beforeDestroy()` lifecycle hook, called by Vue before component removal; no check shown. Stops listening for 'fetch-error-event' and clears window.onbeforeunload.

`fetchDraftFiling()` sends request to `LegalServices.fetchFiling(url: businesses/{identifier}/filings/{filingId})`; receives filing JSON with header, business, annualReport, optional changeOfDirectors and changeOfAddress. Validates structure, type ANNUAL_REPORT, status DRAFT, business identifier and name. Restores: certifiedBy, payment option (FAS/BCOL/NO_FEE/NONE with routing slip, BCOL account details, or flags), AGM date and no-AGM flag, AGM extension flag, directors and addresses (with required presence rules). On error, logs to console and sets `resumeErrorDialog = true`.

Event handlers `officeModifiedEventHandler(modified)`, `directorsPaidChange(modified)`, `directorsFreeChange(modified)` called by child components; no check shown. Set `haveChanges = dataLoaded`, call `updateFilingData('add'/'remove', FilingCodes.ADDRESS_CHANGE_OT/DIRECTOR_CHANGE_OT/FREE_DIRECTOR_CHANGE_OT, false, waiveFees)`.

`onAgmDateChange(val)`, `onAgmExtensionChange(val)`, `onNoAgmChange(val)`: called by child components; no check shown. Set `haveChanges = dataLoaded` and store value.

`onAgmDateValidChange(val: boolean)`: called when AGM date validity changes. Calls `updateFilingData('add'/'remove', FilingCodes.ANNUAL_REPORT_OT, isPriority, waiveFees)`.

`onClickSave()`: called when user clicks Save button; no check shown. Prevents double-save via `busySaving` check. Sets `saving = true`, calls `saveFiling(true)`, catches errors with `saveErrorReason = SaveErrorReasons.SAVE`.

GOTCHA: Error handling logs to console instead of proper logging. GOTCHA: `fetchDraftFiling()` error only sets dialog flag, no retry or re-raise. GOTCHA: Data validation in `mounted()` logs to console and redirects silently. GOTCHA: `updateFilingData()` called but not defined in this chunk.

structured.condensed: Saves a business filing and handles navigation or payment after save completion. Entry points: `onClickSaveFinish()` (called after save, no check shown), `onClickSaveResume()` (user clicks Save and Resume Later or retries from error dialog, no check shown), `onClickSaveResumeFinish()` (called after save-resume, no check shown), `onClickFilePay(fromStaffPayment)` (user clicks File and Pay or retries from error dialog; if user role is staff and not from staff payment dialog, shows staff payment dialog and returns), `onClickFilePayFinish()` (called after file-pay, no check shown), `saveFiling(isDraft)` (caller must catch exceptions). For new filings (filingId === 0), checks `LegalServices.hasPendingTasks(getIdentifier)` and throws if pending tasks exist; on catch, sets `saveErrors`. Extracts filingId from response header, stores in `this.filingId`. On `saveFiling` error with 402 status, sets `haveChanges = false` and `paymentErrorDialog = true`; other errors set `saveErrorReason`. If no error, calls finish handlers. `onClickFilePayFinish()` checks `isPaymentActionRequired`; if true, navigates to payment URL via `navigate(payUrl)` with paymentToken and encoded returnUrl; otherwise calls `navigateToBusinessDashboard(getIdentifier, filingId)`. `onClickSaveResumeFinish()` and `goToDashboard()` call `navigateToBusinessDashboard(getIdentifier)` if filingId valid and haveChanges false or forced. Flags preventing double-save: `busySaving` checked but never set in chunk. All save errors logged to console when filingId invalid. GOTCHA: `busySaving` is checked but this chunk never sets it, so the guard may not prevent double saves. GOTCHA: console.log used instead of proper error handling when filing ID invalid. GOTCHA: `onClickSaveFinish()` calls `onClickSaveResumeFinish()` logic inlined but also has separate handler, creating maintenance risk.

uses.what: Called with getIdentifier, filing object, isDraft flag; creates new filing and returns response with header.filingId

uses.name: navigate
uses.what: Called with payment URL constructed from getAuthWebUrl, paymentToken, and encoded returnUrl; navigates to payment page

uses.name: navigateToBusinessDashboard
uses.what: Called with getIdentifier and optionally filingId; routes to dashboard

uses.name: savedFiling
uses.what: Response object from saveFiling; reads header.filingId, header.isPaymentActionRequired, header.paymentToken

uses.name: saveErrorReason
uses.what: Flag checked to determine if save/file-pay should proceed; set to SaveErrorReasons.SAVE_RESUME or SaveErrorReasons.FILE_PAY on error

uses.what: Dialog shown when isRoleStaff and not fromStaffPayment

structured.condensed:
Part of an Annual Report filing component in a business filing system. Handles unsaved-changes confirmation dialog, AGM date and director action validation for cooperatives, payment and save error recovery flows, and watchers that reload office addresses and directors when the "as of" date changes, update certification state, or adjust staff payment options and filing codes.

Entry points: `onConfirmExit()` opens a confirmation dialog; if user clicks "Exit without saving", sets `haveChanges` to false and navigates to dashboard—no permission check shown. `allowChange(type)` returns true if selected AGM Date >= earliest allowed date (for 'coa' uses last address-change or annual-report date, else founding date; for 'cod' uses last director-change or annual-report date, else founding date). `hasAction(director, action)` returns true if action is in director.actions array. `onPaymentErrorDialogExit()` closes payment error dialog; if user is Staff, stays on Staff Payment dialog, else closes and navigates to dashboard. `onSaveErrorDialogRetry()` closes save error dialog and retries the originating action (`onClickSave`, `onClickSaveResume`, or `onClickFilePay` with staff flag if applicable) based on `saveErrorReason`. `onSaveErrorDialogOkay()` closes save error dialog and calls finish methods (`onClickSaveFinish`, `onClickSaveResumeFinish`, or `onClickFilePayFinish`). Watchers: `onAsOfDateChanged()` ignores changes before `dataLoaded` is true, then fetches original office addresses and directors via component refs with the new date; `onIsCertifiedChanged()` and `onCertifiedByChanged()` set `haveChanges` to `dataLoaded`; `onStaffPaymentDataChanged(val)` applies waive-fees and priority flags to filing codes based on `val.option` and `val.isPriority`, then sets `haveChanges` to `dataLoaded`.

Conditions: Staff role checked in `onPaymentErrorDialogExit()` via `this.isRoleStaff`. Entity type checked in `onStaffPaymentDataChanged()` via `this.isBaseCompany` and `this.isEntityCoop`. Date loading checked in `onAsOfDateChanged()` via `this.dataLoaded`.

GOTCHA: `onConfirmExit()` shows no caller check or permission validation. GOTCHA: `onAsOfDateChanged()` skips fetching if `this.isVitestRunning` is true, leaving data stale during tests.

structured.condensed: Renders a form to file Consent to Amalgamation Out with jurisdiction, delivery, certifier and court order sections. Collects foreign jurisdiction selection (country, region), optional delivery email, certifying officer name, court order number and plan-of-arrangement flag; validates each section independently. Entry point onClickSave() called by Save button saves draft via submitFiling; onClickSaveResume() saves and navigates to dashboard; onClickFilePay() (optionally staff-payment-gated) submits filing and navigates to payment or dashboard. Shows three error dialogs (saveErrorDialog, paymentErrorDialog, resumeErrorDialog) with retry logic on SaveErrorDialog. Loads initial data via dataLoaded flag; displays loading spinner while showLoadingContainer true. Shows fee summary via SbcFeeSummary; displays "File and Pay" or "File Now (no fee)" based on isPayRequired. Court order section visible only if isRoleStaff true. No permission checks shown in component; validation state (showErrors) triggers on user action, not entry point. Certify message uses FilingCodes.ANNUAL_REPORT_OT (appears mismatched to amalgamation context). GOTCHA: Court order section says courtOrderNumberRequired=false, so court order may be empty. GOTCHA: FilingCodes.ANNUAL_REPORT_OT used for Consent to Amalgamation Out messaging.

structured.condensed: Vue component managing a Consent to Amalgamation Out filing form. On creation, reads filingId from route query and validates it; on mount, loads draft filing if filingId > 0, pre-populates certified-by field with logged-in user's name (unless staff), and initializes filing data. User enters certification, court order, foreign jurisdiction, and document delivery details; component validates each section independently and requires all four to be valid. User clicks Save (saves draft, clears haveChanges flag), Save and Resume Later (saves draft, clears flag, navigates to dashboard), or implicitly File and Pay (when isPageValid and isPayRequired). Getters fetch auth URL, business email, legal name, pay API URL, user info, and staff role from three Vuex stores. Component tracks UI state: form validity flags (certifyFormValid, courtOrderValid, foreignJurisdictionValid, documentDeliveryValid), payment data (staffPaymentData with option, routingSlipNumber, bcolAccountNumber, datNumber, folioNumber, isPriority), dialog triggers (saveErrorReason, paymentErrorDialog), and busy flags (saving, savingResuming, filingPaying). fetchDraftFiling() calls LegalServices.fetchFiling() with constructed URL, verifies all required fields present and filing type and status correct, then populates form fields and staffPaymentData from response; on error logs to console and shows resumeErrorDialog. onClickSave() calls saveFiling(true), catches error to set saveErrorReason and extract filing from response, saves filingId, calls onClickSaveFinish() unless error. onClickSaveResume() identical flow but calls onClickSaveResumeFinish() which navigates to dashboard. Before unload, prompts user if haveChanges is true. GOTCHA: error handling in both fetch and save catches error but only logs; does not re-raise or retry. GOTCHA: onClickSaveFinish() and onClickSaveResumeFinish() check filingId > 0 but do not validate save succeeded or filing ID was actually returned.

structured.condensed: Handles File and Pay submission for a Consent to Continue Out filing in a business filing system. Entry points: onClickFilePay() called by user (role check: if staff user, routes via staff payment dialog; otherwise proceeds to file-pay), onClickFilePayFinish() called after save completion, goToDashboard() called by user to exit filing, onPaymentErrorDialogExit() called from payment error dialog, onSaveErrorDialogRetry() and onSaveErrorDialogOkay() called from save error dialog. Validates all form sections (foreign jurisdiction, document delivery, certify form, court order); if invalid, shows errors and scrolls to first failure. Prevents double-saves via busySaving flag. Calls saveFiling(false) to build and persist filing (checks for pending tasks on new filings; constructs header with certifiedBy, email, date, optional document email; includes staff payment routing data if applicable; includes business founding date, identifier, legal name/type; includes foreign jurisdiction country/region and optional court order with file number and plan-of-arrangement flag; sends to LegalServices.createFiling or updateFiling with isDraft=false). On 402 status, treats as partial save and shows payment error dialog. On other save error, shows save error dialog. If filing saved successfully and payment not required, navigates to dashboard; if payment required, extracts paymentToken and filingId, constructs return URL, navigates to payment service. Staff payment option determines header fields: FAS adds routing slip and priority; BCOL adds account, DAT, folio numbers and priority; NO_FEE sets waiveFees flag. Watchers on four validation flags set haveChanges=true; watcher on staffPaymentData updates filing codes and sets haveChanges=true. Dialog flow: unsaved changes confirmation before dashboard exit; payment error prompt (staff stays on staff payment dialog, others go to dashboard); save error retry/okay handlers re-invoke or finish respective operations. GOTCHA: saveFiling comments show API reassigns date; code does not verify paymentToken exists before constructing pay URL; save error handler may continue with null filing if response lacks data.

structured.condensed: Style configuration for a consent amalgamation view. Defines spacing, typography, and layout for a multi-section form with auto-numbered headings (via CSS counter), card-based content, header and footer sections, and left/right button containers. Resets header counter to 0 in the root container, increments by 1 before each h2, applies theme variables for colors ($gray7, $gray5, $app-red, $px-14) and spacing (margins, padding). Sets line-height and font-size on v-card elements. Styles buttons with 0.5rem gaps; applies left alignment default with .buttons-right using margin-left: auto. Deep scoped rules override font-size and color for document-delivery, court-order-label, poa-label, and text classes (certify-clause, certify-stmt, grey-text) to ensure consistency. Highlights invalid states for certify and foreign-jurisdiction with $app-red text color on title-label and certify-stmt. GOTCHA: no responsive breakpoints shown for button layout at small viewports; buttons-left hardcoded to 50% width may overflow or wrap unexpectedly.

structured.condensed: A filing form UI that collects and validates a Consent to Continue Out submission, then saves or files it. Accepts foreign jurisdiction selection, document delivery email, certifier name, and optionally (for staff) court order number and plan of arrangement flag. Shows validation errors on demand. Saves draft to backend; if file-and-pay is clicked and fees apply, opens payment dialog (staff payment or external payment URL). Transitions show a loading spinner during initial data load, then displays form sections: Jurisdiction Information (valid when country and region selected), Documents Delivery (valid when email addresses provided), Certify (valid when certifier name entered; staff can edit, others cannot), and Court Order (staff only; optional court number). Before filing, confirms all info is correct. Entry points: Save (button click, any user), Save and Resume Later (button click, any user), File and Pay (button click, any user; payment required check gated by isPayRequired flag), Cancel (button click, any user). Sends draft to backend save endpoint; on file-and-pay, posts to payment URL with filing data or opens staff payment dialog. Errors from save or resume are caught and shown in dialogs; file payment errors also surface. GOTCHA: no permission check shown in this component; no duplicate filing guard; certifier validation calls Certify component but name is not re-validated here after entry; court order validity check depends on CourtOrderPoa component state.

structured.condensed: Vue component for Consent to Continue Out filing: handles validation, saving (draft or final), payment-triggered filing, and dashboard navigation. Entry points: `onClickFilePay()` (user clicks File and Pay, or retry from Save Error or Staff Payment dialog; no permission check shown), `onClickFilePayFinish()` (internal completion), `saveFiling(isDraft)` (builds and saves filing; caller must catch exceptions), `goToDashboard(force)` (navigate if no pending changes; no permission check shown), `onPaymentErrorDialogExit()` (respond to payment error), `onSaveErrorDialogRetry()` and `onSaveErrorDialogOkay()` (respond to save error). Main flow: validate page and form, prevent double-save, route staff users through Staff Payment dialog, save filing via `LegalServices.saveFiling()` (update if `filingId > 0`, else create), handle 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED status (clear `haveChanges`, show payment dialog, return filing), catch other save errors, then complete with payment navigation or dashboard routing. Decisions: `isPageValid` → scroll to invalid component; `busySaving` → return early; `isRoleStaff && !fromStaffPayment` → show Staff Payment dialog; `filingId > 0` → update filing else create; error status 402 → payment dialog and clear changes, else save error dialog; `isPaymentActionRequired` → navigate to Pay URL with token and return URL, else dashboard; `haveChanges && !force` → confirm before exit. Before `saveFiling()` completes, checks pending tasks for new filings via `LegalServices.hasPendingTasks()`. Watchers on form fields set `haveChanges = true`; staff payment data watcher calls `updateFilingData()`. GOTCHA: No duplicate guard on file-pay submission. GOTCHA: Payment error handler shows errors only via dialog, logs invalid filing ID to console only. GOTCHA: Comment on line shows API reassigns date; check that server clock is correct.

structured.condensed: Vue template that displays and collects information for a Continuation Out business filing. Users enter an effective date, select a foreign jurisdiction and region, provide a business name, specify document delivery emails, certify by legal name, and optionally enter a court order number or select plan of arrangement. The page shows a fee summary sidebar. Four main action buttons: Save (stores draft), Save and Resume Later (stores draft), File and Pay or File Now (submits and processes payment if required), Cancel (returns to dashboard). Each input section validates on form submission and displays error styling. Three error dialogs handle resume failures, save failures with retry, and file/pay failures. A loading spinner shows during initial page load. No entry point checks are shown in this template.

structured.condensed:
Vue component for staff to file a Continuation Out, a business transition between jurisdictions.

Comes in: filingId query param (new filing if 0, draft if > 0). Goes out: calls saveFiling() to POST filing data. 

Flow: (1) On create, checks isRoleStaff; throws error and shows resumeErrorDialog if not staff. (2) On mounted, if filingId > 0, calls fetchDraftFiling() to load stored state into initialEffectiveDate, initialCountry, initialRegion, initialBusinessName, certifiedBy, fileNumber, hasPlanOfArrangement, documentOptionalEmail; catches errors to resumeErrorDialog. (3) Always adds FilingCodes.CONTINUATION_OUT with Waive Fees flag true. (4) Watches child component refs (effectiveDateRef, foreignJurisdictionRef, businessNameForeignRef, certifyRef) for validity. (5) On Save: calls saveFiling(true) with catch to set saveErrorReason and savedFiling; if success, clears haveChanges; if filingId returned, updates this.filingId. (6) On Save and Resume later: same save flow then navigates away.

Decisions: isPageValid combines six validity flags (effectiveDateValid, certifyFormValid, foreignJurisdictionValid, businessNameValid, documentDeliveryValid, courtOrderValid). isPayRequired returns totalFee > 0. showLoadingContainer shows when !dataLoaded && !saveErrorReason. busySaving combines saving, savingResuming, filingPaying flags.

fetchDraftFiling validates filing structure (header.name === CONTINUATION_OUT, header.status === DRAFT, business.identifier matches, business.legalName matches), extracts legalName/continuationOutDate/courtOrder/foreignJurisdiction, maps effectOfOrder to hasPlanOfArrangement via EnumUtilities.isEffectOfOrderPlanOfArrangement().

Entry point: mounted via route query param filingId. Check: throws error if !isRoleStaff; navigates to dashboard if filingId isNaN.

GOTCHA: error in fetchDraftFiling() is only logged to console and resumeErrorDialog set; no retry. GOTCHA: saveFiling() error catch returns error?.response?.data?.filing which may be null; filingId > 0 check is insufficient if returned filing lacks header.filingId. GOTCHA: saveFiling(true) called but implementation not shown; payload and target endpoint unknown.

uses.what: called with argument true (draft flag); implementation not shown; response includes filing with optional header.filingId and header.documentOptionalEmail; errors caught to set saveErrorReason and extract error?.response?.data?.filing

structured.condensed: UI component that saves and files a continuation out business filing. Saves a draft or final filing by posting to LegalServices, which returns a filing with ID and optional payment details. If no draft exists elsewhere, saves final filing; if payment is required (402 response), redirects to payment URL with token; otherwise routes to dashboard. Three entry points: `onClickSave()` (anyone, no check shown), `onClickSaveResume()` (anyone, no check shown), `onClickFilePay()` (anyone; checked: valid page, not staff-only, but staff parameter unused). Each calls `saveFiling()`, which checks pending tasks only for new filings, builds header with `certifiedBy`, email, date, optional document email, and `waiveFees: true`; builds business section with founding date, identifier, legal name, type; builds data with continuation out date, country/region, business name, and optional court order (file number, plan of arrangement flag). On success: saves filing ID, clears `haveChanges`, routes to dashboard or payment URL based on `isPaymentActionRequired`. On error (not 402): sets `saveErrorReason`, shows errors/warnings. Dialog handlers retry or finish based on reason. Validation checked before save: certify form, effective date, jurisdiction, business name, document delivery, court order; all watchers set `haveChanges = true`. GOTCHA: `onClickFilePay` parameter `staffPayment` is received but never used. GOTCHA: No retry logic or transactional save if filing persists but ID extraction fails. GOTCHA: Payment URL reachability assumed, no retry mechanism if navigation fails.

uses.what: Checks if identifier has pending tasks; called only on new filing (filingId === 0); throws error caught and re-thrown after setting saveErrors.

uses.what: Updates existing filing (filingId > 0) with assembled header/business/data object and isDraft flag; returns filing or throws with errors/warnings in response.data.

uses.what: Creates new filing (filingId === 0) with assembled header/business/data object and isDraft flag; returns filing or throws with errors/warnings in response.data.

uses.what: Routes to dashboard with optional identifier and filing ID parameters.

uses.what: Validates components and scrolls to first invalid one; takes validFlags and validComponents arrays.

uses.name: this.$refs.certifyRef.$refs.certifyTextfieldRef.error
uses.what: Sets error flag on certify textfield when page is invalid.

uses.name: this.$refs.confirm.open
uses.what: Opens confirmation dialog for unsaved changes; resolves on Yes, rejects on Cancel.

uses.name: FilingTypes.CONTINUATION_OUT
uses.what: Constant string for filing type name in header and data object keys.

uses.name: EffectOfOrderTypes.PLAN_OF_ARRANGEMENT
uses.what: Constant string used as effectOfOrder when hasPlanOfArrangement is true.

uses.name: SaveErrorReasons.SAVE
uses.what: Constant identifying save error reason; triggers retry of onClickSave.

uses.name: SaveErrorReasons.SAVE_RESUME
uses.what: Constant identifying save-resume error reason; triggers retry of onClickSaveResume.

uses.name: SaveErrorReasons.FILE_PAY
uses.what: Constant identifying file-pay error reason; triggers retry of onClickFilePay.

uses.name: StatusCodes.PAYMENT_REQUIRED
uses.what: HTTP 402 status code; when received, filing is saved and haveChanges cleared, but no other error is set.

structured.condensed: Dashboard view displaying business filing status and company information. Renders five main sections: Alerts (conditionally shown if count > 0), To Do list with legal obligations, Pending Staff Review (if items exist), Recent Filing History, and a sidebar with Custodian of Records (for historical entities), Office or Business Addresses, and Current Directors or Proprietor/Partners (based on entity type). Address section shows "Pending" badge if change of address is effective-dated, displays disable state during bootstrap filing/pending. Sidebar only renders directors "Change" button if !isDisableNonBenCorps && !isHistorical. For firm entities, renders Proprietor section (sole prop) or Partners section; for others, renders Directors section. Clicking "Change" on addresses triggers onAddressChangeClick() if AllowableActions.ADDRESS_CHANGE is allowed, opening CoaWarningDialog which—if proceeded—calls goToStandaloneAddresses(). Clicking "Change" on directors/proprietor calls goToChangeFiling() if AllowableActions.DIRECTOR_CHANGE is allowed, or goToStandaloneDirectors() for non-firm non-bootstrap cases. Child components emit counts that update local alertCount and todoCount. StaffNotation emits @close with reloadDataIfNeeded(). Displays coaEffectiveDate in Pacific time when change is pending.

Entry points: `onAddressChangeClick()` (routes user based on entity type: Firm navigates to Edit UI, base company shows COA warning dialog, others proceed to standalone addresses; no permission check shown), `goToStandaloneDirectors()` (routes to new COD filing), `goToChangeFiling()` (navigates to external change URL), `goToStandaloneAddresses()` (routes to new COA filing), `toggleCoaWarning()` (toggles `coaWarningDialog`), `reloadDataIfNeeded(needed: boolean)` (emits 'reloadData' event if true).

Inbound data from Vuex stores: `getHistoryCount`, `getPendingCoa` (ApiFilingIF with `effectiveDate` field), `getParties` (PartyIF[] filtered for Roles.CUSTODIAN), `getPendingsList`, `isBootstrapFiling`, `isBootstrapPending`, `isBootstrapTodo`. Computed properties: `pendingCount` (length of getPendingsList), `isCoaPending` (truthy check on getPendingCoa), `coaEffectiveDate` (Date from getPendingCoa.effectiveDate or null), `businessId` (from sessionStorage BUSINESS_ID), `filingId` (cast from route query.filing_id, may be NaN), `custodians` (filtered parties).

GOTCHA: Commented-out getter `isRoleStaff` suggests a permission check was removed or disabled.

uses.what: Vue Router navigation to Routes.STANDALONE_DIRECTORS or Routes.STANDALONE_ADDRESSES with filingId query parameter (0 indicates new filing)

uses.what: External navigation to edit URL with entity identifier appended for change or firm editing

uses.name: $root.$emit
uses.what: Event emission of 'reloadData' when reloadDataIfNeeded(true) called

uses.what: Interface type with effectiveDate field for pending COA

uses.name: Routes.STANDALONE_DIRECTORS

uses.what: Route name constant for standalone addresses filing

structured.condensed:
Vue template for the Change of Directors filing edit and review page. Displays a form to enter the date of director changes and manage director information, then a review page with certifier name. Reads initial director and filing data; reads Date and Directors components to collect changes; computes whether edit page is valid from codDateValid, directorFormValid, and directorFormValid conditions. On Save, saves draft. On Save and Resume Later, saves draft with resume flag. On Review and Confirm, if edit page valid, shows review page; from review, must certify (isCertified and certifiedBy set) before File and Pay becomes enabled. File and Pay opens StaffPaymentDialog to capture payment method, then calls onClickFilePay(true) which triggers payment; errors show in PaymentErrorDialog with errors/warnings lists and exit or retry options. If save fails during draft or resume, SaveErrorDialog shows errors/warnings with okay/retry/exit; retry calls onSaveErrorDialogRetry(). On initial load or after navigation, shows loading spinner with loadingMessage. If isFetching, shows alternate grayed overlay spinner. Fetch errors show FetchErrorDialog with exit to dashboard. Resume errors show ResumeErrorDialog with exit to dashboard. ConfirmDialog used for confirmations. Cancel or exit dialogs navigate to dashboard via goToDashboard().

GOTCHA: Payment errors and save errors both use errors/warnings lists but unclear which list corresponds to which error type or validation rule. GOTCHA: Retry logic for save errors calls onSaveErrorDialogRetry() but no explicit guard against duplicate submissions shown. GOTCHA: directorFormValid assigned from Directors component but also referenced in isEditPageValid computation alongside codDateValid—dependency chain not shown in this chunk.

structured.condensed: Standalone Director Change filing UI: allows users to enter and certify director information, set an effective date, review the filing, and optionally pay the filing fee. Entry points are the mounted() lifecycle hook (invoked by Vue when component loads) which fetches a draft filing if filingId > 0 else prepares a new filing, and the public method onClickFilePay() (called by user clicking the "File and Pay" button, no permission check shown). Data flows: fetches existing directors via directorsComponent.getOrigDirectors(), displays COD Date, Directors form, Certify form, and fee summary, validates across isEditPageValid and isReviewPageValid checks. On mount, if filingId > 0 it calls LegalServices.fetchFiling(businesses/{identifier}/filings/{filingId}) to resume a draft, restoring certifiedBy, staffPaymentData, and codDate from filing.header; if filingId is NaN or missing identifier, navigates to dashboard. The component saves unsaved changes by showing an onbeforeunload warning if haveChanges is true. GOTCHA: no permission check shown for who may call onClickFilePay(); GOTCHA: resuming draft filing assumes filing.header contains certifiedBy, routingSlipNumber or bcolAccountNumber or waiveFees, with no guard against missing values; GOTCHA: staffPaymentData.option is initialized to StaffPaymentOptions.NONE but only staff can set other options, yet no role check is shown in this chunk.

structured.condensed: Restores and saves a Change of Directors business filing with optional draft mode. Incoming: filing data with optional directors list (array of director objects), staff payment options (FAS, BCOL, NO_FEE, NONE), certified-by name, code date, priority flag. Outgoing: filing object sent to LegalServices.createFiling or LegalServices.updateFiling with header (name, certifiedBy, effectiveDate, routing/account details per payment option), business (foundingDate, identifier, legalName, legalType), and directors array. Main flow: fetch draft filing and restore directors if present (throw error if changeOfDirectors exists but directors array empty); when directors modified via onDirectorsPaidChange or onDirectorsFreeChange, set haveChanges flag and call updateFilingData with appropriate fee code; on onClickSave call saveFiling(true) and clear haveChanges if filingId > 0 obtained; on onClickSaveResume call saveFiling(true) then navigate to dashboard if successful; on onClickFilePay call saveFiling(false), capture paymentToken and isPaymentActionRequired from response, redirect to Pay URL or navigate to dashboard. Entry points: fetchDraftFiling (private method, callable from constructor/initialization), onDirectorsPaidChange and onDirectorsFreeChange (UI handlers for director changes), onClickSave/onClickSaveFinish (user clicks Save or retry from dialog), onClickSaveResume/onClickSaveResumeFinish (user clicks Save and Resume later), onClickFilePay/onClickFilePayFinish (user clicks File and Pay; if isRoleStaff and not fromStaffPayment, detour to staffPaymentDialog instead). saveFiling helper checks LegalServices.hasPendingTasks(identifier) for new filings (throw if pending exist); builds header with payment option details via switch on staffPaymentData.option; sends filing via LegalServices.createFiling (new) or LegalServices.updateFiling (existing). Decisions: changeOfDirectors included in filing only if hasFilingCode(feeCode) or hasFilingCode(freeFeeCode); payment action required determines redirect to Pay URL vs dashboard navigation. Error handling: fetch errors logged to console and show resumeErrorDialog; save/file-pay errors caught, saveErrors and saveWarnings extracted from response, paymentErrorDialog shown on 402 status, dialogs may finish process later. GOTCHA: console.log used for errors instead of proper error handling; no explicit permission check shown for entry points; "assume Pay URL is always reachable" with no timeout or retry logic; director data set by paid/free events rather than saveFiling, creating implicit dependencies.

uses.name: filing (from input/cache)
uses.what: object containing changeOfDirectors with optional directors array; if directors array exists and is empty, an error is thrown

uses.name: LegalServices.hasPendingTasks
uses.what: checks for pending tasks on identifier; if call fails, saveErrors set and exception re-raised; used only for new filings (filingId === 0)

uses.name: LegalServices.createFiling
uses.what: creates new filing with header (name: CHANGE_OF_DIRECTORS, certifiedBy, email, date, effectiveDate, plus payment-specific fields), business (foundingDate, identifier, legalName, legalType), and directors; isDraft parameter; exception caught and errors/warnings extracted

uses.name: LegalServices.updateFiling
uses.what: updates existing filing with same structure as createFiling; uses filingId parameter; isDraft parameter; exception caught and errors/warnings extracted

uses.name: updateFilingData
uses.what: called with action (add or remove), fee code, priority flag, and waiveFees flag when directors change

uses.name: getAuthWebUrl
uses.what: base URL for payment redirect; used to construct payUrl with paymentToken and encoded returnUrl

uses.name: navigate
uses.what: navigates browser to payUrl constructed from getAuthWebUrl, paymentToken, and filingId

uses.name: navigateToBusinessDashboard
uses.what: navigates to dashboard with identifier and filingId parameters when payment not required

uses.name: goToDashboard
uses.what: navigates to dashboard after save-resume completes

uses.name: FilingTypes.CHANGE_OF_DIRECTORS
uses.what: constant for filing type name in header

uses.name: StaffPaymentOptions
uses.what: enum with options FAS, BCOL, NO_FEE, NONE; matched in switch statement to set header payment fields

uses.name: SaveErrorReasons
uses.what: enum with values SAVE, SAVE_RESUME, FILE_PAY; assigned to saveErrorReason on catch

uses.name: StatusCodes.PAYMENT_REQUIRED
uses.what: HTTP 402 status code; when error response matches, special handling clears haveChanges and shows paymentErrorDialog

structured.condensed: Handles user navigation, dialog responses, and data changes in a Vue component for Change of Directors filings. Entry points: `goToDashboard(force)` routes to dashboard if no changes or force=true, else opens unsaved-changes confirmation dialog that either closes (Yes) or discards changes and routes (Cancel); callable by any user with no check shown. `showReviewPage()` toggles to review display, scrolls to top. `showEditPage()` toggles to edit display, scrolls to top. `onPaymentErrorDialogExit()` closes payment error dialog; if staff role stays on staff payment dialog, else routes to dashboard. `onSaveErrorDialogRetry()` retries the save operation matching `saveErrorReason` (SAVE, SAVE_RESUME, or FILE_PAY). `onSaveErrorDialogOkay()` finishes the save operation matching `saveErrorReason`. `hasAction(director, action)` checks if director.actions contains action. Watchers: `onCodDateChanged()` refetches original directors for new COD date when loaded; `onIsCertifiedChanged()`, `onCertifiedByChanged()`, `onStaffPaymentDataChanged()` set `haveChanges=dataLoaded`. `onStaffPaymentDataChanged()` applies priority flag to feeCode if present, adds/removes waive-fees flag to all filing codes based on StaffPaymentOptions.NO_FEE. GOTCHA: `goToDashboard()` no permission check. GOTCHA: unsaved-changes dialog does not disable body interaction. GOTCHA: retry logic catches nothing, failure handling not shown.

structured.condensed: Allows users to change a business's Registered Office Address (and Records Address for base companies), certify the change with an authorized person's name, and file with optional payment. Displays office address and certify form sections; validates all fields before enabling File button. Calls LegalServices to save draft or submit filing; shows fee summary and payment dialog for staff users. On save, persists filing and address changes; on file, submits to payment processor if fee required. Retrieves initial filing data via LegalServices; shows FetchErrorDialog on fetch failure. Disables Save/Resume buttons until addresses and fee data valid; disables File until all forms valid. Shows loading spinner during fetch and page init. Offers Save, Save and Resume Later, File and Pay (or File Now if no fee), and Cancel buttons; Cancel returns to dashboard. SaveErrorDialog retries on user request; PaymentErrorDialog exits to dashboard. GOTCHA: component has no check that form data changed before enabling save buttons—depends on upstream form component onChange events.

structured.condensed: Vue lifecycle and event handlers for a Change of Address filing component. Entry points: `created()` — initializes filing data, listens for fetch errors, sets up unsaved-changes warning, parses filing ID from route query (no permission check shown); `mounted()` — validates entity identifier and filing ID, loads current date, either resumes draft or prepares new filing by fetching original addresses from OfficeAddresses child component (skipped in Vitest); `beforeDestroy()` — cleans up listeners. `fetchDraftFiling()` — calls LegalServices to GET `businesses/{identifier}/filings/{filingId}`, verifies filing type is CHANGE_OF_ADDRESS and business matches, restores Certified By, Staff Payment data (FAS/BCOL/NO_FEE/NONE option), and Change of Address addresses if present; throws on validation failure, caught and logged, sets `resumeErrorDialog = true`. `officeModifiedEventHandler(boolean)` — records changes and updates filing data. `onClickSave()` — calls `saveFiling(true)` for draft, extracts filing ID from response, clears `haveChanges` if no error (no error dialog check shown, relies on later handling). `onClickSaveResume()` — calls `saveFiling(true)` for draft, sets `saveErrorReason` on catch, clears `haveChanges` and navigates dashboard if successful. `onClickFilePay()` — detours staff users to payment dialog first; calls `saveFiling(false)` for final filing; on 402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED clears `haveChanges` and shows payment dialog; on other errors sets `saveErrorReason = SaveErrorReasons.FILE_PAY`. Saves filing before later steps fail. GOTCHA: `created()` and `mounted()` show no check enforcing who may access this component. GOTCHA: `fetchDraftFiling()` throws on validation failure but payload is already fetched; partial restoration may occur before throw. GOTCHA: `saveFiling()` implementation not shown; return value and error structure inferred from catch blocks only.
